transcriptZh:
大家好，我是余秋雨。我们现在开始进入到全年课程的最后一部分，中国文脉的记忆序列。上次我讲到了王羲之和陶渊明，我把他们的两篇文章都做了翻译，翻译以后给大家朗读了一下，王羲之的是《兰亭集序》，陶渊明的是《归去来兮辞》，大家一定都有个印象。按照中国文脉的思路，我不能每一个点都讲到，现在毫无疑问，按照我第一部分的思路，现在一定要呼唤唐代了，伟大的唐代。
到唐代，其实在我们这个课程的第一部分，我花了很长的时间，在讲唐代的社会气氛，现在西安的朋友们听了以后反应非常强烈，他们很多机关、好多学校都在听我有关唐代长安时候的各种各样的情景。但是我上次已经预告，就是唐代文学的具体的作品，我要放到最后一部分慢慢地来欣赏，那这个时候就到了。
关于唐诗的五点记忆
我们现在，和我们前面讲到的伟大的唐代的那种气象所呼应，我们现在要讲到唐诗了，唐代的文学或者说唐代的文脉，它的主干就是唐诗。而且唐诗不完全是唐代文学的主干，它也是整个中国文学的主干之一。你在海外遇到华人，开始的时候可能两个人，讲一些汉语，讲的还不错，但如果要讲深入，你要了解他的文化水准呢，一般的说，比较愚蠢的方式就问学历，比较聪明的方式，就是提几句唐诗，有感应的话，一般的说来就可以判断，他是一个有文化的华文投入者。所以大体已经可以说明，唐诗是一个人中国文化修养的起点之一，或者说是基础之一，这个非常重要。
我们在唐诗的记忆这个概念里边，我们要花一点时间，不仅仅是课程上花一点时间，还需要大家在日常生活当中，也在唐诗里边多花一点时间，因为这决定我们对中国文化的认定，也决定你对中国文化的熟悉和了解程度。
那么，唐诗到底要记多少呢？我相信我们每个学员对这一点都比较的苦恼，因为从我们有的电视节目看起来，现在有的朋友唐诗都记了很多很多，很陌生的唐诗，他们也随口吐出。这一点，大家一方面对他们产生佩服，同时对我们自己产生了某一种惊慌，说我是一个对中国古典文学也不是完全陌生的人，但是那些唐诗我怎么全部都不知道，所以就产生了一个叫唐诗的记忆范围，记忆程度，它的划分，这一点平心而论，本身就是一门学问，历来争议也很多。
这个我想讲下面几点，供大家参考，我讲五点有关唐诗的记忆。这个我相信对于好多语文老师来说很重要，其实对我们每个个人也很重要，提高我们的文化素养。
第一点，我的观点是唐诗实在太繁荣了。繁荣是什么意思呢？就是它的量大，而且质高。因为量大，因为质高，我们反而要把住记忆之门，哪一首都记的话，那你的脑子就要爆炸了，太大了这个量，不能多多益善。如果多多益善的话，唐诗就会成为一个非常沉重的记忆负担，成为一个非常沉重的记忆负担以后，它减损了诗歌所需要的潇洒和轻灵的愿望，因此我希望学员们能够对唐诗的选择越严格越好。
选择本身就是判断你品味的一个考验，我问你，你如果选十首你选多少？二十首你选哪几首？这都是对你的考验，看你的品位，如果说我一下子记它个五百首，或者记它个一千首，我觉得反而证明你只是个电脑而已，反而没有品味。这第一条。
第二条，唐诗历来已经比较普及，对唐诗的记忆我们要提高要求，就是最重要的唐诗我们要学会背熟，能够随口吐出。吐出的时候，就像我前面讲的，你在外国，不仅是在外国，在一般聊天的时候，也经常会提到唐诗来互相之间了解对方的文化程度，唐诗应该成为中国语言中的通行的古典元件。但是我们要让元件真的成为元件，而不要成为零件。我现在在电视节目里边看到好多人对古典诗词，就变成了一种零件了，散散落落的一大堆，就像一个你的工具间里边所有的零件乱抛一样，你说这好吧？不好，因为这完全不管用，所以要变成元件，元件的话，最重要的元件哪几项？第二次等的元件哪几项？要清清楚楚。这是第二条。
第三条，唐诗的背诵，我说最重要的唐诗要背诵，但是这个背诵又因为唐诗的篇幅不同，还要有一些区别。譬如我们一般希望学员熟练背诵的总是是五绝、七绝、五律、七律，就这些体裁，而那些篇幅较长的古体的歌行，虽然很重要，但是我把它放到扩大记忆的范围，就是第二等的记忆范围。譬如像李白的《梦游天姥吟留别》，白居易的《长恨歌》，张若虚的那个《春江花月夜》，这些其实都很重要，李白、白居易、张若虚都很重要，这几首诗也很重要，但是我没有放在必须背诵的部分，因为篇幅长了一点，我们放在，你如果有比较多的时间可以稍稍的背诵，不背诵也不要紧，熟读也可以。
第四点，唐诗有个排序的问题。我所说的，譬如几首几首，它有一个重要性与否，值得背诵不背诵与否，这么个排序，这个排序很有学问了。这我希望我们所有的老师，听我课的大学和中学老师，教古典文学的老师，你们注意一下，就是我们到底以什么标准来选择唐诗，那就需要有排序了。
排序是这样的，中华书局出了一本叫《唐诗排行榜》。这个书其实蛮好的，有严谨和科学的价值。它选了什么？它基于唐诗在古代和现代被入选、被评点的各种数据，选到哪一本诗里，选的次数多少，还有被多少学者提到、点评到。但是，我更看重的是历代民众熟悉和传颂的程度，因为老百姓的熟知和传颂，它牵涉到文化人类学上的很多问题，为什么老百姓喜欢这一首，你学者们点评的不多，但是为什么老百姓喜欢这一首？老百姓喜欢这一首，它一定有各种各样的原因，这个原因你看上去老百姓没文化，不是，那恰恰牵涉到人类文化学的问题。就是为什么它打动了普通人的心？为什么那个时代打动，后面又打动了，一次次打动，什么道理？
在这个意义上，学者们的入选和学者们写评论文章的多寡，虽然也要照顾，但是更重要的是在社会上它被传颂、被传播的程度，这一点非常重要，因为传颂其实是一种筛选和淘汰。一代代传颂，一代代淘汰，所以现在的传颂其实比古代的传颂更重要。这首诗在唐代的传颂没有今天的传颂重要，另外，今天那么多年过去了，它居然还在传诵，一定有非常重大的理由。
我的唐诗选择
唐诗的排列，还有一个问题，到底是以诗人来归并排列，还是以诗作来归并排列？我们很多选本着眼于诗歌的体例和内容，譬如《唐诗三百首》用的就是体例，譬如这是七绝，这是五绝，这是个体例，体例里边再分人。那么，我呢是以人作为排列，排列基本的一个次序，就是李白、杜甫、王维、白居易这么一个个排下来，那李白里边哪一首诗放在前面呢？那需要看历史资料，历史上他被重视的程度，不管学术界还是民间，他重视到什么程度。
这样的话，我讲了上面这五点原则以后，我就排定了我们这门课程里边必须记忆、基础记忆和扩大记忆的唐诗的范围。这也是件大事，我来怎么划分我们上这门课的学员们必须记的唐诗、必须背的唐诗是哪几首？量是多少？
对这个问题，平心而论，我花了几十年的功夫，一直在推敲，思考这个问题。因为我很早就觉得，作为一个中国年轻人，他脑子里边留下的那些唐诗的熟悉的句子有多少？这个很重要。
清代的时候编《唐诗三百首》，那平心而论，这是清代的当时的生活节奏，清代的那些文化人，他的兴趣容量。按照这个标准，按照我们今天看起来，三百首肯定是多了，而且太多了。因为让一般的普通的年轻人，他的生活节奏和兴趣容量是有限的，要背三百首那显然太多了，而且内容上和我们现在区别很大，我前面讲到了，老百姓非常喜欢的那些诗，他有的时候没收入，把一些从现在看起来已经很难有感应力的诗，还收了不少。
后来上世纪六十年代，又出版过《唐诗一百首》这样的版本，现在看起来也多了，我们如果要一百首，完全是让现在的年轻人按照他们的生活节奏来背一百首的唐诗，我觉得也多了。
后来十几年前，西安曲江新区，曲江新区大家知道，长安的时候状元游曲江是一个非常重要的活动，曲江是唐诗的重要的故地。他们为了吸引中外游客，希望能够刻一些唐诗的碑，这是唐诗的一个重要的吟诵地，要刻碑，他们就叫我做顾问来问我，你看要收多少首？我说，你这个碑是给谁看的？他刻是给一般的中外游客看的。我说既然给中外游客看的，我想，最多二十首，不能太多了，密密层层变成了碑林，一般游客就很难在那儿停下步来仔细的看了，二十首。因为还要刻碑，所以这个没办法。
按照我的学员来说，记二十首太少了，因为刻碑，二十首这个量是严格了一点，但是我们要记的话又不要刻碑，我们只是刻在我们脑子里，二十首就太少了。
所以，我经过反复地掂量，反复权衡，反复推敲，我决定选五十首唐诗，是我们这个课程的学员应该背诵的，然后再后备四十首，这后备四十首不要背诵，你只要熟读就可以了。当然在课程里边听我课的，所有我直接指导的博士研究生，我希望后面四十首也应该熟悉到可背诵的程度。
好，大家明白了没有？我这门课程选的必须背的唐诗是五十首，这五十首，后备四十首，这是熟读，我所指导博士生这九十首都必须能够背诵，但是前五十首要背得很熟练。这一点如果明白的话，我现在就要隆重的公布，哪五十首的篇目了，希望大家能够记一记，但是我这今后这个课完了以后，会出一本书。
这个如果光记，可能用耳朵听的时候有一点难度，但是我反复坚持这一点，让大家的耳朵能够有一个耳善，都好像听到过了。所以，我还是要读，一首一首的读，读重要的句子，让大家觉得我听到过。我因为想起我小学的时候都讲唐诗，我的小学老师就读过以后，我们这些孩子们的脑子当中，多少年以后还记得，我们跟着读，但是都还记得。你像我小的时候在浙江农村，读的都是方言，老师也是方言，尽管后来年纪大了以后，记住这些句子的时候也是方言，后来需要矫正，但是因为听到过，就记住了。那个句子有的时候，这些字、这些文句，我们当时还不太懂，小孩嘛，所以听还是重要的。
李白《早发白帝城》
必须背诵的唐诗的基础，入选的第一首，是李白的《早发白帝城》，无论是古代和现代，很多资料表明，这首诗可以放在第一位。诗是这样的，我想我们在座的各位都能够背诵。
“朝辞白帝彩云间，千里江陵一日还。两岸猿声啼不住，轻舟已过万重山。”
这首诗是这样的，简单说来就是，大家知道李白在安史之乱，就是安禄山之乱的时候，他很想参加平叛，但是跟错了人，他这个跟错也不是他的错，是当时唐朝的政治版图上的错误。当时接班的肃宗，和他的弟弟永王李璘产生了对立，产生了矛盾。虽然都是在平叛那个安史之乱，但是他们两个就矛盾起来了，在这个过程当中，当时李白所在的庐山，正好是永王李璘的地盘，他在李璘的招呼下他就参加了他的幕府，成了他的智囊。所以，后来皇家两个儿子产生矛盾的时候，李白就算站错队了，站错队了以后，由于很多人对他的诬陷，由于好多人对他的使坏，所以他就下狱了。尽管没有死，但是要流放，流放到很远的地方去，流放夜郎。
但是，后来在一年多以后，公元759年，因为当时中国有旱灾，关中大旱，那么皇帝经常是这样，遇到自然灾害，他就要放一些犯人来表示对老天爷的某一种恳求，大赦天下。那么这个时候，李白就被恕免了，恕免了，就是不用远远的去流放夜郎，那太远了，所以他就可以无罪了，罪是有罪，被恕免了。那个时候，李白其实已经快六十岁了，年纪已经老了，那这个时候他就非常高兴，有罪之身突然可以自由了，于是他就从白帝城出发，到江陵去。
你看，“朝辞白帝彩云间，千里江陵一日还。两岸猿声啼不住，轻舟已过万重山”，他是多么多么的高兴，那高兴之情都表达出来了，但是我不能不说，他这次被恕免以后走的旅程，其实非常痛苦。尽管他那么高兴，但他到哪里去呢？他没有薪水，他没有工作单位，他其实就靠旁人的接济才能过日子。所以，他最后是找到了他的一个族叔，找他的族叔，找当涂县令的一个族叔，那么才在那儿过日子。
所以，我就觉得，这是一个我们伟大的诗人最后一次意气风发，最后一次充满了兴奋感的对大自然的穿越，所以这首诗，我们把它放在第一首了。
那今天讲到这儿，我们下次再讲。
transcriptEn:
Hello everyone, my name is Yu Qiuyu. We are now entering the last part of the full-year course, the memory sequence of Chinese context. Last time I talked about Wang Xizhi and Tao Yuanming. I translated two of their articles and read them aloud to everyone. Wang Xizhi's was "Preface to the Lanting Collection" and Tao Yuanming's was "Returning to the Songs". Everyone must have an impression. According to the idea of ​​​​Chinese cultural context, I cannot talk about every point. Now there is no doubt that according to the idea of ​​​​my first part, now we must call for the Tang Dynasty, the great Tang Dynasty.
In the Tang Dynasty, in fact, in the first part of our course, I spent a long time talking about the social atmosphere of the Tang Dynasty. Now my friends in Xi’an reacted very strongly after listening to it. Many of their agencies and schools are listening to me about various scenes in Chang’an in the Tang Dynasty. But I already announced last time that I would put the specific works of Tang Dynasty literature into the last part and appreciate them slowly, so that time has come.
Five memories about Tang poetry
Echoing the atmosphere of the great Tang Dynasty we mentioned earlier, we are now going to talk about Tang poetry. The backbone of the literature of the Tang Dynasty, or the context of the Tang Dynasty, is Tang poetry. Moreover, Tang poetry is not entirely the backbone of Tang Dynasty literature, it is also one of the backbones of Chinese literature as a whole. When you meet a Chinese overseas, there may be two people who speak some Chinese at first, and they can speak quite well. But if you want to talk in depth, you need to understand his cultural level. Generally speaking, the stupid way is to ask about his academic qualifications. The smart way is to mention a few Tang poems. If something resonates with him, generally speaking, you can judge that he is an educated Chinese devotee. Therefore, it can be roughly stated that Tang poetry is one of the starting points, or one of the foundations, of a person's Chinese cultural accomplishment. This is very important.
We need to spend a little time on the concept of memory of Tang poetry, not only in the course, but also in daily life, and in Tang poetry, because this determines our identification of Chinese culture and also determines your familiarity and understanding of Chinese culture.
So, how many Tang poems should be memorized? I believe that every one of our students is quite troubled by this, because from some of our TV programs, some of our friends have memorized many Tang poems, and they spit out very unfamiliar Tang poems casually. At this point, everyone admires them on the one hand, and at the same time has a certain panic about ourselves, saying that I am not a complete stranger to Chinese classical literature, but I don't know all those Tang poems, so there is a memory range, degree of memory, and division called Tang poetry. To be fair, this is a knowledge in itself, and there have always been many disputes.
I would like to talk about the following points for your reference. I will talk about five points about the memory of Tang poetry. I believe this is very important for many Chinese teachers. In fact, it is also very important for each of us to improve our cultural literacy.
First, my point is that Tang poetry is too prosperous. What does prosperity mean? That is, its quantity is large and its quality is high. Because of the large quantity and high quality, we have to keep the door of memory closed. If you memorize every song, your brain will explode. The quantity is too large, and the more the better. If more is better, Tang poetry will become a very heavy memory burden. After becoming a very heavy memory burden, it will detract from the unrestrained and light desire required for poetry. Therefore, I hope that students can be as strict as possible in the selection of Tang poetry.
The choice itself is a test to judge your taste. Let me ask you, if you choose ten songs, how many would you choose? Which of the twenty songs would you choose? This is a test for you. It depends on your taste. If I memorize 500 poems at once, or memorize 1,000 poems at once, I think it proves that you are just a computer and have no taste. This is the first one.
Second, Tang poetry has always been relatively popular. We need to raise the requirements for memorizing Tang poetry. That is, we must learn to memorize the most important Tang poetry and be able to spit it out casually. When spitting out, as I said before, when you are in a foreign country, not only in a foreign country, but also when chatting in general, you will often mention Tang poetry to understand each other's cultural level. Tang poetry should become a popular classical element in the Chinese language. But we need to make the components really components, not parts. I see a lot of people on TV programs now treating classical poetry like parts, scattered in a pile, just like all the parts scattered around in your tool room. Do you think this is okay? No, because this doesn't work at all, so it needs to be turned into a component. If it is a component, what are the most important components? What components are waiting for the second time? Be clear. This is the second one.
The third item is the recitation of Tang poems. I say that the most important Tang poems should be recited, but there are some differences in this recitation due to the different lengths of Tang poems. For example, what we generally hope students can recite proficiently are Wujue, Qijue, Wulu, Qilu, just these genres. Although those longer ancient-style songs are very important, I put them in the scope of expanded memory, which is the second-level memory scope. For example, Li Bai's "Sleepwalking Tianmu Says Farewell", Bai Juyi's "Song of Everlasting Sorrow", and Zhang Ruoxu's "Spring River Flower Moonlight Night". These are actually very important. Li Bai, Bai Juyi, and Zhang Ruoxu are all important. These poems are also very important, but I have not put them in the part that must be recited, because the length is a bit longer. Let's put it here. If you have more time, you can recite it briefly.
The fourth point is that there is a problem of ordering in Tang poetry. What I am talking about is, for example, how many songs are there, whether they are important or not, whether they are worth reciting or not, this sorting is very knowledgeable. I hope that all our teachers, the university and middle school teachers who take my classes, and the teachers who teach classical literature, will pay attention to what criteria we use to select Tang poetry, and then there needs to be a sorting.
The ranking is like this. Zhonghua Book Company has published a book called "Tang Poetry Ranking". This book is actually quite good, with rigorous and scientific value. What did it choose? It is based on various data on how Tang poetry has been selected and commented on in ancient and modern times, including which poetry book it was selected for, how many times it was selected, and how many scholars mentioned and commented on it. However, what I value more is the degree of familiarity and praise among the people of the past dynasties, because the familiarity and praise among the common people involves many issues in cultural anthropology. Why do the common people like this song? You scholars have not commented much, but why do the common people like this song? The common people like this song, and there must be various reasons for it. This reason seems to you that the common people are uneducated, but no, that just involves issues of human culture. Is that why it touches the hearts of ordinary people? Why was it that I was moved at that time, and then moved again later, again and again? What’s the reason?
In this sense, although the selection of scholars and the number of commentaries written by scholars should also be taken into consideration, what is more important is the extent to which it is praised and disseminated in society. This is very important, because praise is actually a kind of screening and elimination. It has been passed down from generation to generation and eliminated from generation to generation, so the current eulogies are actually more important than the ancient eulogies. The popularity of this poem in the Tang Dynasty was not as important as its popularity today. In addition, there must be a very important reason why it is still being recited after so many years.
My choice of Tang poetry
There is another question regarding the arrangement of Tang poems: should they be arranged based on poets or based on poems? Many of our anthologies focus on the style and content of poetry. For example, "Three Hundred Tang Poems" uses style. For example, this is the seven unique styles, this is the five unique styles, and this is the individual style. The styles are divided into people. Well, I am arranging them based on people, and the basic order is Li Bai, Du Fu, Wang Wei, and Bai Juyi. Then which poem by Li Bai is placed first? Then we need to look at the historical data and the extent to which he was valued in history, whether in academia or among the people, to what extent he was valued.
In this case, after I talked about the five principles above, I determined the scope of Tang poetry that must be memorized, basic memorized and expanded memorized in our course. This is also a big deal. How should I classify the Tang poems that our students taking this course must memorize? Which Tang poems must be memorized? What is the quantity?
To be fair, I have spent decades thinking about this issue. Because I have long felt that as a young Chinese man, how many familiar sentences from Tang poems are left in his mind? This is very important.
In the Qing Dynasty, "Three Hundred Tang Poems" was compiled. To be fair, this was the rhythm of life in the Qing Dynasty at that time, and the interest capacity of the cultural people in the Qing Dynasty. According to this standard, according to what we see today, three hundred songs are definitely too many, and too many. Because the pace of life and interest capacity of ordinary young people are limited, three hundred poems to memorize is obviously too much, and the content is very different from what we have now. As I mentioned before, he sometimes has no income from those poems that the common people like very much, and he has collected a lot of poems that are difficult to be sensitive to now.
Later, in the 1960s, another edition was published called "One Hundred Tang Poems", which seems to be too much now. If we want a hundred poems, it is completely to let today's young people memorize a hundred Tang poems according to their pace of life. I think it is too much.
Later, more than ten years ago, Xi'an Qujiang New District, as everyone knows in Qujiang New District, it was a very important event for the number one scholar to visit Qujiang in Chang'an, and Qujiang was an important hometown of Tang poetry. In order to attract Chinese and foreign tourists, they hoped to carve some stele of Tang poetry. This is an important place for reciting Tang poetry. To carve a stele, they asked me to be their consultant and asked me, how many do you think they should include? I said, who is this monument for? His carvings are for ordinary Chinese and foreign tourists to see. I said that since it is for Chinese and foreign tourists, I think there should be at most twenty poems, not too many. The dense layers have turned into a forest of steles, and it would be difficult for ordinary tourists to stop there and read carefully, twenty poems. Since we still have to engrave a monument, there is nothing we can do about it.
According to my students, memorizing twenty poems is too few, because the amount of twenty poems is a bit strict for engraving on monuments, but if we want to memorize them, we don’t need to engrave them on monuments. We just engrave them in our minds, and twenty poems are too few.
Therefore, after repeated weighing, weighing, and deliberation, I decided to choose fifty Tang poems that students in our course should memorize, and then reserve forty poems. You don’t need to memorize these forty poems, you just need to read them familiarly. Of course, all the doctoral students who are listening to my lectures in the course and I directly supervise them, I hope that the next forty poems will also be familiar enough to recite.
Okay, do you understand? The 50 Tang poems that I have chosen to memorize for this course are 50, and there are 40 in reserve. This is for familiarity. The doctoral students I supervise must be able to recite these 90 poems, but the first 50 must be memorized very proficiently. If you understand this, I will now solemnly announce the contents of the fifty poems. I hope everyone can take note of them. But in the future, after I finish this class, I will publish a book.
If you just memorize this, it may be a little difficult to listen to it with your ears, but I insist on this repeatedly so that everyone's ears can have a good ear, and they all seem to have heard it. Therefore, I still have to read, one by one, and read the important sentences, so that everyone feels that I have heard them. I remembered that when I was in elementary school, I was taught Tang poetry. After my elementary school teacher read it, we children still remember it in our minds many years later. We read it along, but we still remember it. Like when I was a child in rural Zhejiang, all I read were in dialect, and the teacher also spoke in dialect. Even though when I got older, I still remembered these sentences in dialect. Later, I needed to correct them, but because I heard them, I remembered them. Sometimes in that sentence, we didn’t quite understand these words and sentences at the time, as children, so it was still important to listen.
Li Bai's "Early Departure from Baidi City"
The basis of Tang poetry that must be recited, the first one selected is Li Bai's "Early Departure from Baidi City". Whether it is ancient or modern, many data show that this poem can be ranked first. The poem is like this. I think all of us here can recite it.
"In the midst of the colorful clouds of the White Emperor, thousands of miles of rivers and mountains are returned in one day. The apes on both sides of the bank can't stop crying, and the light boat has passed the Ten Thousand Mountains."
This poem is like this. To put it simply, everyone knows that during the Anshi Rebellion, that is, the Anlushan Rebellion, Li Bai wanted to participate in countering the rebellion, but he followed the wrong person. His mistake was not his fault, but a mistake on the political map of the Tang Dynasty at that time. Suzong, who succeeded him at that time, had an opposition and conflict with his younger brother Yong Wang Li Lin. Although they were both fighting against the Anshi Rebellion, the two of them had conflicts. In the process, Lushan, where Li Bai was located at that time, happened to be the territory of Yongwang Li Lin. At Li Lin's invitation, he joined his shogunate and became his think tank. Therefore, when the two sons of the royal family had conflicts, Li Bai was on the wrong team. After he was on the wrong team, many people framed him and caused mischief to him, so he was imprisoned. Although he did not die, he was exiled to a far away place, and Yelang was exiled.
However, more than a year later, in 759 AD, because there was a drought in China at that time, a severe drought in Guanzhong, the emperor often did this. When encountering natural disasters, he would release some prisoners to express some kind of plea to God and grant amnesty to the world. Then at this time, Li Bai was forgiven. Forgiveness meant that he did not have to go far to exile Yelang. That was too far, so he was not guilty. The crime was guilty and he was forgiven. At that time, Li Bai was actually almost sixty years old, and he was already old. At this time, he was very happy, and his guilty body was suddenly free, so he set off from Baidi City to Jiangling.
You see, "Cha Ci Bai Di is among the colorful clouds, and thousands of miles of rivers and mountains are returned in one day. The apes on both sides of the bank can't stop crying, and the boat has passed the Ten Thousand Mountains." He was so happy, and his joy was expressed. But I have to say that the journey he took after being spared this time was actually very painful. Even though he was so happy, where was he going? He has no salary and no job. He actually relies on the help of others to survive. Therefore, he finally found one of his clan uncles, his clan uncle, and a clan uncle of Dangtu County Magistrate, and then he lived there.
Therefore, I feel that this is our great poet's last high-spirited and exciting journey through nature, so we put this poem first.
That’s it for today, we’ll talk about it next time.

summary.gistZh: 唐诗是中国人文化修养与美学启蒙的天然起点，它用凝练的韵律与意境将审美、情感、哲学与家国情怀完美融入日常记忆。
summary.gistEn: Tang Poetry is the natural starting point for Chinese cultural literacy and aesthetics—blending music, philosophy, and emotion into timeless collective memory.

highlights.zh: 全民文化起点：从小背诵的唐诗构成了全球华人共同的美学基因与情感底色。
highlights.en: Universal Literacy Foundation: Verses memorized in childhood form the shared aesthetic DNA and emotional resonance of Chinese people globally.

highlights.zh: 语言的极致艺术：将汉字的声音美、意象美与节奏感发挥到极致，不可替代也不可等翻译完全替代。
highlights.en: Pinnacle of Language Art: Pushing the acoustic, visual, and rhythmic beauty of Chinese characters to its ultimate height.

highlights.zh: 博大的精神气象：从李白的雄浑浪漫到杜甫的沉郁顿挫，涵盖了人类心灵的所有情感光谱。
highlights.en: Vast Spiritual Horizons: From Li Bai's cosmic romanticism to Du Fu's tragic realism, spanning every emotional spectrum of humanity.

highlights.zh: 诗意地栖居：唐诗让中国人即使在困顿与逆境中，依然能保有诗意的心灵与高尚的情趣。
highlights.en: Living Poetically: Tang poetry enables Chinese people to maintain poetic dignity and spiritual elevated taste even amidst suffering.
